app.name: AI-Learning System
app.description: AI-Learning System creates a personalized learning experience that adapts to your knowledge, learning speed, strengths and weaknesses.

features.title: Personalized Learning
features.description: Every student gets a unique learning path tailored to their knowledge level, strengths, and weaknesses.

features.title: AI-Based Recommendations
features.description: Our AI engine analyzes your performance and recommends the best next topic, resource, or activity.

features.title: Smart Revision
features.description: Spaced repetition algorithms ensure you revisit concepts at the optimal time for long-term retention.

features.title: Adaptive Quizzes
features.description: Quizzes that adapt in difficulty based on your answers, providing the right level of challenge.

features.title: Progress Analytics
features.description: Detailed dashboards showing your learning progress, accuracy trends, and areas to improve.

features.title: AI Tutor
features.description: Get instant explanations, examples, and guidance from an AI tutor available 24/7.
